title: Identification of FTY720 and COH29 as novel topoisomerase I catalytic inhibitors by experimental and computational studies.
authors: Zeng, Huang; Zhang, Shengyuan; Nie, Hua; Li, Junhao; Yang, Jiunlong; Zhuang, Yuanbei; Huang, Yingjie; Zeng, Miao
one_liner_zh: 该文通过实验与计算结合鉴定TOP1催化抑制剂，涉及蛋白-DNA互作界面（TOP1-DNA结合腔）的分子对接与MD模拟，但对象为拓扑异构酶而非转录因子，方法可迁移至TF-DNA体系，故评5分。
abstract: The development of novel topoisomerase I (TOP1) inhibitors is crucial for overcoming the drawbacks and limitations of current TOP1 poisons. Here, we identified two potential TOP1 inhibitors, namely, FTY720 (a sphingosine 1-phosphate antagonist) and COH29 (a ribonucleotide reductase inhibitor), through experimental screening of known active compounds. Biological experiments verified that FTY720 and COH29 were nonintercalative TOP1 catalytic inhibitors that did not induce the formation of DNA-TOP1 covalent complexes. Molecular docking revealed that FTY720 and COH29 interacted favorably with TOP1. Molecular dynamics simulations revealed that FTY720 and COH29 could affect the catalytic domain of TOP1, thus resulting in altered DNA-binding cavity size. The alanine scanning and interaction entropy identified Arg536 as a hotspot residue. In addition, the bioinformatics analysis predicted that FTY720 and COH29 could be effective in treating malignant breast tumors. Biological experiments verified their antitumor activities using MCF-7 breast cancer cells. Their combinatory effects with TOP1 poisons were also investigated. Further, FTY720 and COH29 were found to cause less DNA damage compared with TOP1 poisons. The findings provide reliable lead compounds for the development of novel TOP1 catalytic inhibitors and offer new insights into the potential clinical applications of FTY720 and COH29 in targeting TOP1.
abstract_zh: 新型拓扑异构酶I（TOP1）抑制剂的开发对于克服现有TOP1毒剂的缺陷和局限性至关重要。在此，我们通过对已知活性化合物的实验筛选，鉴定出两种潜在的TOP1抑制剂，即FTY720（一种鞘氨醇1-磷酸拮抗剂）和COH29（一种核糖核苷酸还原酶抑制剂）。生物学实验证实，FTY720和COH29是非嵌入型TOP1催化抑制剂，不诱导DNA-TOP1共价复合物的形成。分子对接揭示FTY720和COH29与TOP1具有良好的相互作用。分子动力学模拟表明，FTY720和COH29可影响TOP1的催化结构域，从而导致DNA结合腔尺寸的改变。丙氨酸扫描和相互作用熵分析将Arg536确定为热点残基。此外，生物信息学分析预测FTY720和COH29可能有效治疗恶性乳腺肿瘤。生物学实验使用MCF-7乳腺癌细胞验证了它们的抗肿瘤活性。还研究了它们与TOP1毒剂的联合效应。进一步发现，与TOP1毒剂相比，FTY720和COH29引起的DNA损伤更少。这些发现为开发新型TOP1催化抑制剂提供了可靠的先导化合物，并为FTY720和COH29在靶向TOP1方面的潜在临床应用提供了新见解。
